acceptedAnswer.text: A one-time-purchase device for one small enclosed room. It monitors humidity and temperature, scores a room-level Mold Risk Index, and runs a built-in thermoelectric dehumidifier automatically. The companion app shows status, alerts and control.

mainEntity.name: How does it detect mold risk?

acceptedAnswer.text: It scores the conditions mold needs rather than looking for mold. The Mold Risk Index combines humidity, temperature and how long those conditions persist, instead of a single humidity threshold, plus a dew-point estimate for condensation on cold surfaces.
Yes. MoldGuard contains its own thermoelectric dehumidifier: when the index crosses its threshold it starts pulling moisture from the air, and stops once conditions return to range.

mainEntity.name: Why not just buy a cheap dehumidifier?

acceptedAnswer.text: A dehumidifier dries when you switch it on. MoldGuard also decides when that should happen, using humidity, temperature and how long the room has stayed damp rather than one humidity reading. You are paying for the sensing and the automatic response in the same unit. If you only need a fan and a compressor on a manual switch, a cheaper unit covers that.

mainEntity.name: How long until I get it?

acceptedAnswer.text: MoldGuard is built to order rather than shipped from stock. Your quotation confirms build time, delivery and any service coverage before you commit. No payment is taken on this site.

Live status for the room: the readings behind the score, humidity and temperature history, alerts, and manual override when the device is online. The app is a companion to the device; monitoring and dehumidification run on the unit itself.

mainEntity.name: Can I monitor more than one room?

acceptedAnswer.text: One MoldGuard is scoped to one small enclosed room. Multi-room and multi-unit views are not part of this offer; ask about multiple units in your quotation.

mainEntity.name: How do I set it up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Place it tabletop or wall-mounted and pair it with the companion app on Wi-Fi. Local Bluetooth control is also part of the design. Ask the team to confirm placement, setup requirements and support for your room in the quotation.

mainEntity.name: What happens if the internet goes down?

acceptedAnswer.text: The device keeps monitoring and dehumidifying on its own, and local Bluetooth control keeps working. Remote status, alerts and app control need the device online.
Emptying the removable 1-litre reservoir, whose fill level is monitored so you are told before it is full. The device uses electricity and needs regular tank emptying.

mainEntity.name: Does it work without the internet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Local monitoring, the risk logic and dehumidification run on the device. Live status and history in the app, alerts, and remote override are the parts that need a connection.

The proposed one-time selling price is ₱9,994: one payment for the hardware, with no subscription or monthly monitoring fee. Electricity and routine maintenance are separate from the purchase price. Your quotation confirms the final price and terms.

mainEntity.name: What room size does it handle?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is intended for one small enclosed room such as a cupboard, bathroom, basement or small bedroom, and it is sized around that. Confirm suitability for your room in the inquiry; larger or open-plan spaces are outside scope.

Renters and small property owners with one humidity-prone room, and anyone who would rather buy a device once than pay a monitoring subscription. It is not a mold clean-up service: existing growth needs professional remediation.
